task.title: Show tooltips in the desktop sidebar
task.description:
No native tooltip appears anywhere in the desktop app's sidebar on macOS (Workbench dev build at 8772e27, Electron 44.2.0). Dylan hovered with a real pointer: the rail's project tiles (name and path), the rail's category fold button (full category name), and the expanded sidebar's category name and chevron all show nothing. The title attributes are set in desktop/src/renderer/app.js (projectRow item.title, categoryGroup head.title and toggle.title, the version line), and the renderer tests assert them, so the DOM is right; the native tooltip never shows.

The sidebar has been its own WebContentsView (chromeView in desktop/src/main/main.js) beside the board views since c5338a1 'Let the main process own a collapsible sidebar', first shipped in desktop-v0.6.0-rc1, so the released app likely has this too.

Find the root cause (for example: tooltips in a WebContentsView that is not the focused webContents, the board view or the window's own webContents sitting over the sidebar, or the title-row drag region) and fix it so every sidebar tooltip shows on hover without moving keyboard focus out of the board. The rail depends on tooltips most: its tiles show only a key and its category buttons only initials.

Acceptance: hovering a rail tile, a rail category button, the expanded sidebar's category header and the version line each shows its tooltip on macOS; keyboard focus stays where it was; a test or check guards the cause where one can.
